JACK SNIP 1.0.1

Double-click JackSnip.exe. No installation required.

Click Snip, drag an area, and release. Pen is selected automatically.
Ctrl+C copies the image with all annotations. Capturing never automatically copies.
Ctrl+S saves a PNG; Ctrl+Shift+S chooses a new filename.

Pen: draw with different widths and colors.
Circle/Arrow: drag to create; choose a color.
Check: click to place a green boxed check or drag to size it.
Select: move stickers; drag corners to resize, or arrow endpoints to turn.
Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y: undo / redo. Delete removes the selected annotation.

Settings > Keyboard shortcut changes the global snipping shortcut.
Default: Ctrl+Alt+S. Keep the app running for the global shortcut.

Closing the window leaves a small tray process and releases the screenshot.
Click the tray icon to snip. File > Exit quits entirely.
Settings > Run at sign-in is optional and disabled by default.

Keep the app in a writable folder; JackSnip.ini is created beside it when
you save shortcut settings. Keep the accompanying runtime notices if sharing.
